title: Business Development Lead – Marketplace
description:
**Job Title: Business Development Lead – Marketplace**

**Location: Vikhroli, Mumbai (On\-site)**

**About Us:**

Launched in 2020, Beshak is an online insurtech platform that helps customers discover and buy insurance plans. We are a platform that will not team up with insurers on commissions, ensuring we are 100% unbiased. We have built a community of real experts who can assist the customer right from purchase to claims. As a growing early\-stage startup, we thrive on innovation, ownership, and freedom in the workplace, where every individual contributes meaningfully to our success.

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a sharp, self\-driven Supply Lead to own the entire advisor supply engine of the Beshak Marketplace \- from identifying different streams and screening advisors, to training and certifying them, taking them live, and ensuring they remain engaged, productive, and retained.

The single measure of this role is the number of advisors live on the platform. An advisor is live only when they are onboarded, trained, certified, compliant, and actively receiving leads \- sign\-ups without go\-live do not count.

This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role \- You will be the single point of accountability for advisor supply health, and are expected to bring onboarding chase, training rigour, data discipline, scalable systems and people skills together to build a thriving advisor community.

**Key Responsibilities**

Advisor Supply \& Onboarding Advisor Experience Ownership

– Own end\-to\-end advisor acquisition \- sourcing from different forums, managing the complete screening process, ensure onboarding of the advisor, and activation

– Maintain a consistent pipeline to onboard advisors as per Demand targets.

– Ensure Supply ≥ Demand at all times; proactively close supply gaps before they impact business

– Diversify sourcing streams so supply is never dependent on a single channel \- referrals, agency channel, community networks, digital inbound and partner\-led sourcing

Advisor Training, Certification \& Readiness

– Own pre\-onboarding training as a mandatory gate \- no advisor goes live without completing the prescribed training and clearing certification

– Design, run and continuously improve the advisor training curriculum \- platform and dashboard usage, Beshak's advice philosophy and unbiased positioning, product and category basics, customer communication standards, compliance and complaint prevention, and the incentive structure

– Run structured assessments and scenario\-based evaluations; maintain a defensible pass/fail standard and a re\-attempt policy

– Maintain training records, certification status and refresher cycles for every advisor, and trigger re\-training where quality or complaint signals demand it

– Work with Customer Success, Compliance and Product to keep training content current as processes and platform features change

Onboarding, Activation \& Go\-Live

– Drive the onboarding chase relentlessly \- documentation, agreements, empanelment, code creation, dashboard access and first lead assignment

– Reduce time\-to\-live and eliminate stalled cases; maintain a clean, current view of every advisor stuck between sign\-up and go\-live, with reasons

Advisor Engagement \& Retention

– Drive Advisor NPS through proactive relationship management, feedback loops, and timely resolution

– Maintain advisor retention rate; conduct regular touchpoints and engagement initiatives

– Identify early warning signals of disengagement \- falling response rates, declining conversion, quota under\-utilisation \- and intervene before churn

Demand\-Supply Management

– Continuously monitor supply\-demand ratio and advisor quota utilisation

– Flag and resolve demand\-supply imbalances proactively and cross\-functionally

– Forecast supply requirements against the business plan and build the pipeline ahead of demand, not in reaction to it

Field Engagement \& Partnership Building

– Proactively visit advisors in person to build meaningful, trust\-based relationships that go beyond transactional interactions

– Identify partnership opportunities with high\-performing advisors, regional managers, branch managers to co\-create growth \- through referral networks, community influence, and collaborative outreach

Systems, Data \& Team Ownership

– Own the supply dashboard \- pipeline, training and certification status, go\-lives, churn, utilisation \- as the single source of truth for management review

– Design scalable, documented processes and automate repetitive chase and reporting work so supply scales without headcount scaling linearly

– Lead and develop the supply\-side team as the function scales, and represent supply in cross\-functional forums with Product, Tech, Customer Success and Compliance

Success Metrics

– Primary: Advisors live on platform, net live adds per month, supply\-demand ratio

– Secondary: Sourced\-to\-live conversion, time to live, certification pass rate, advisor retention at 90/180 days, Advisor NPS, quota utilisation

– Guardrail: Ageing and closure of advisor dues and recoverables

**Requirements**

● Candidates with 2\-5 years of experience in the Founder's Office or Business Strategy will be preferred.

● Demonstrated experience in training, enablement or capability building for a distributed sales force will be strongly preferred.

● On\-site role in Vikhroli, Mumbai (remote candidates will not be considered).

● Strong interest in sales, systems, automation, and process design.

● Ability to think in problem statements, workflows, and root causes, not just execution.

● Experience managing a distributed field force, advisor network, or franchise partner ecosystem will be preferred.

● Proven ability to own supply\-side metrics independently without hand\-holding.

● Comfort with data \- building and reading dashboards, working in spreadsheets, and defending numbers in a review.

● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

● High ownership, proactive attitude, and comfort operating in ambiguity.

**What We Offer**

● A flat, open work culture with real ownership and team leadership to be a decision\-making authority.

● Rapid growth in responsibility and compensation based on performance.

● Exposure to product, tech, and ops decision\-making in a fast\-scaling startup.

● A chance to build scalable systems from scratch instead of managing broken ones.

● Direct visibility with the founding team \- supply health is a board\-level number at Beshak.

title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONPosition: Sales Manager

**Department:** Sales  
**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra / India  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** HR Technology / SaaS  
**Product:** QHRM – Human Resource Management Software  
**Reporting To:** General Manager / Business Head

1\. Job Summary

We are looking for a result\-oriented and experienced **Sales Manager** to lead and drive sales growth for QHRM's HRMS/SaaS solutions in the Indian market.

The Sales Manager will be responsible for generating new business, managing the sales pipeline, conducting product demonstrations, converting qualified leads into customers, developing customer relationships, and achieving monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

The ideal candidate should have strong **B2B sales experience**, preferably in SaaS, HRMS, ERP, CRM, payroll, or other technology solutions, with proven experience in consultative selling and team management.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesSales \& Business Development

* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.
* Identify and generate new business opportunities through outbound calls, email campaigns, LinkedIn, referrals, networking, and other channels.
* Prospect and qualify potential customers across target industries.
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline from lead generation to closure.
* Conduct product presentations and online/offline demonstrations of QHRM.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable QHRM modules and solutions.
* Prepare and deliver customized sales proposals, quotations, and commercial presentations.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts within approved company guidelines.
* Drive the complete sales cycle from prospecting through closure and handover to implementation/support teams.

Team Management

* Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team to achieve assigned targets.
* Allocate leads and territories effectively among team members.
* Conduct regular sales meetings and pipeline reviews.
* Monitor individual team performance and provide coaching and guidance.
* Support team members in handling difficult prospects, negotiations, and closures.
* Set daily/weekly activity targets for calls, meetings, demos, and follow\-ups.

Pipeline \& Performance Management

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date sales records in the CRM.
* Monitor lead conversion, demo\-to\-sale conversion, sales cycle, and revenue performance.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports for management.
* Analyse sales performance and identify gaps and opportunities.
* Forecast sales revenue based on the current pipeline.
* Ensure timely follow\-up on all qualified leads and opportunities.

Market Development

* Identify new industries, customer segments, and geographical markets for QHRM.
* Conduct competitor and market research.
* Track competitor products, pricing, features, and market positioning.
* Provide customer and market feedback to the Product, Marketing, and Management teams.
* Support marketing campaigns, webinars, events, and other lead\-generation initiatives.

Customer Relationship Management

* Build strong relationships with prospects and customers.
* Understand customer pain points and business requirements.
* Ensure smooth transition of closed customers to the implementation/customer success team.
* Support account expansion and cross\-selling/upselling opportunities.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the customer lifecycle.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Sales Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Monthly and quarterly revenue achievement
* New customer acquisition
* Number of qualified leads generated
* Lead\-to\-demo conversion rate
* Demo\-to\-customer conversion rate
* Sales pipeline value
* Sales closure rate
* Average sales cycle
* Customer acquisition cost
* Team target achievement
* Individual sales representative productivity
* Follow\-up and CRM discipline
* Upselling and cross\-selling revenue

4\. Required Skills

* Strong B2B sales and business development skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
* Consultative selling approach.
* Good understanding of SaaS and technology sales.
* Ability to conduct product demonstrations.
* Strong leadership and team\-management skills.
* Excellent follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Data\-driven approach to sales management.
* Good knowledge of CRM and sales reporting tools.
* Ability to work independently and achieve targets under deadlines.

5\. Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:

* SaaS
* HRMS / HR Tech
* Payroll Software
* ERP
* CRM
* Business Software
* IT Products / Solutions
* B2B Technology Solutions

6\. Qualification \& Experience

**Education:**  
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Management, IT, or a related field.

**Experience:**

* 2\-5 years of overall sales experience.
* Minimum 1\-2 years of experience in a Sales Manager / Team Lead / Business Development Manager role.
* Experience in B2B SaaS or software sales is preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets.

7\. Desired Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* Target\-oriented and commercially driven.
* Confident in dealing with HR Heads, Business Owners, CEOs, Founders, and senior decision\-makers.
* Comfortable with cold calling and outbound sales.
* Strong in product pitching and demonstrations.
* Capable of handling objections and negotiations.
* A good team leader and coach.
* Self\-motivated, disciplined, and accountable.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced SaaS environment.

8\. Compensation

**Salary:** As per experience, skills, and market standards.  
**Incentives:** Performance\-based incentives linked to individual and team sales achievement.

9\. Working Relationship

The Sales Manager will work closely with:

* General Manager / Business Head
* Marketing Team
* Product Team
* Implementation Team
* Customer Support Team
* Finance \& Administration

10\. Role Objective

The primary objective of the Sales Manager is to **build a predictable and scalable sales pipeline, acquire new QHRM customers, achieve revenue targets, and develop a high\-performing sales team in the Indian market.**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From ₹500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Sales specialist Panel Builder
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Sales Manager \#\#\#


**What we believe in**



At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.


**Your role and responsibilities**



In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will meet both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your skills by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.



The work model for the role is: \#Li\-Onsite



The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Buildings Business to be based at Mumbai, India.


**You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Communicate with customers regarding delivery timelines, payments, and terms in alignment with ABB’s strategy while ensuring a positive customer experience throughout the sales process.
* Facilitate marketing initiatives, promote ABB’s value proposition, and identify new market opportunities to expand business reach.
* Manage sales administration, support cash collection, and coordinate with project management to ensure smooth execution of orders.
* Build productive relationships with panel builders and industrial end users with experience in the Mumbai market


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical / Electronic Engineering.
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in sales or business development within the electrical industry.
* Proficient in building and maintaining long\-term relationships with customers by addressing their needs and ensuring satisfaction.
* Experience in handling panel builders and industrial end users, with extensive exposure to the Mumbai market.
* Skilled communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to enhance customer engagement and business growth.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across divisions and countries, promoting knowledge sharing and teamwork.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a history of resolving complex issues and delivering value\-added solutions.


**More about us**



ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

The role involves managing day\-to\-day accounting entries, maintaining financial records, reconciliations, and supporting the finance team with accurate and timely accounting work.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Pass daily accounting entries in **Tally Prime** – Purchase, Sales, Payment, Receipt, Contra, Journal, Debit/Credit Notes.
* Record vendor bills with correct **GST and TDS** details.
* Maintain sales, purchase, expense and TDS records.
* Create and maintain ledgers and ensure proper accounting classification.
* Perform **bank, vendor, customer and ledger reconciliations**.
* Maintain receivables and payables ageing schedules.
* Reconcile **GSTR\-2B with books** and identify mismatches.
* Maintain supporting documents, bills and accounting records.
* Assist with **month\-end/year\-end closing** and audit requirements.
* Use Excel for accounting data, reconciliations and reporting.
* Follow accounting processes and highlight discrepancies or unusual entries.

### **Requirements**

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification.
* **1–3 years of hands\-on accounting experience.**
* Strong knowledge of **Tally Prime** and accounting entries.
* Good working knowledge of **GST and TDS**.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel** – VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Pivot Tables and reconciliation formulas.
* Familiarity with GST Portal and TRACES is an added advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to handle high\-volume accounting work independently.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* Someone who is **strong in Tally and accounting fundamentals**.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Good understanding of reconciliations and financial records.
* Consistent, organised and responsible with accounting data.
* Willingness to identify and resolve discrepancies rather than overlook them.

### **Role Outcome**


The ideal candidate should be able to independently manage **day\-to\-day Tally entries, maintain clean accounting records, complete reconciliations and support the finance team with accurate books.** **Location:** Mumbai \| On\-site

title: Senior Vice President, Asset Management, India
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Senior Vice President, Asset Management, India
  
  

About JLL
  
  

**JLL (NYSE:** JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our vision is to reimagine the world of real estate, creating rewarding opportunities and amazing spaces where people can achieve their ambitions. In doing so, we will build a better tomorrow for our clients, our people and our communities. JLL is a Fortune 500 company with annual revenue of $20 billion, operations in over 80 countries and a global workforce of more than 112,000 as of 2025\. JLL is the brand name, and a registered trademark, of Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated.
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

JLL’s Hotels \& Hospitality division is a global business which partners with investors, owners and operators to support and shape investment strategies that deliver maximum value from commercial real estate. No other advisory or brokerage team in the world provides as broad a spectrum of services for hotel \& hospitality investors. A partnership with JLL gives our clients a single point of contact for support in: acquisition advice, asset management, financing, investment sales, project and development services, operator selection and contract negotiation, research consultancy, strategic advisory, valuations, and value recovery.
  
We are an agile, solution\-focused business whose primary aim is to exceed client expectations. We assemble teams of experts who deliver integrated services built on intuitive market foresight, sound research and relevant market knowledge. We attract, develop and reward the best people, challenging them to develop enduring client relationships built on quality service, collaboration, and trust.
  
We are currently seeking a Senior Vice President, Asset Management, India. This is a new role and is a permanent, full\-time position based in Mumbai or Gurgaon, reporting into the Managing Director, JLL Hotels India in New Delhi. JLL are the leading hotel asset manager in Asia Pacific and are now looking to launch its platform in India under the leadership of the successful candidate.
  
  

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Successfully create, implement and monitor, value accretive hotel asset management strategies for clients in India.
  
Work with the highly regarded JLL Hotels team in India as well as the regional Hotel Asset Management leadership to establish JLL as the leading international hotel asset manager.
  
Lead the business development for asset management in India, including PR/communications, marketing, lead generation, pitching, engagement negotiation and closing.
  
Own the P\&L for the India asset management business, including setting and delivering annual revenue and profitability targets as the platform scales.
  
Lead a small, yet impactful, team of hotel specialists delivering on our asset management services to clients.
  
Recruit, develop and grow the India asset management team in line with portfolio growth, building bench strength for future leadership.
  
Drive thought leadership in asset management through collaboration with the JLL research team and the Hotels \& Hospitality AP research team.
  
Champion the adoption of data analytics and AI\-enabled tools in asset performance reporting and client deliverables, in line with JLL's broader technology and data agenda.
  
As a member of the extended hotels leadership team in India, contribute to the growth of the business across all service lines.
  
  

EXECUTION RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Meet with owners and hotel executive teams to review monthly and quarterly operating performance, review, evaluate and approve annually prepared business plans/budgets, including capital budgets and longer\-term strategic plans to provide cost reduction and revenue enhancement guidance.
  
For pre\-opening assignments, work with owners and hotel executive teams to review pre\-opening, OS\&E, IT and first operating budget including the commercial business plan and work through milestones and critical paths to target a successful hotel opening.
  
Travel to the properties as needed to inspect the facilities, meet with management and tour the market areas and competitive set of hotels.
  
Identify, analyse and implement opportunities for increased revenues and expense savings. Develop ownership and investment strategy for assigned hotels including identifying asset redevelopment, highest and best use, and repositioning opportunities designed to optimize value.
  
Establish operating profit expectations, monitoring performance, and working directly with the on\-site property teams to maximize and improve operating fundamentals.
  
Review, benchmark and analyse hotel\-and portfolio\-level financial data and keep informed of the dynamics of each market area to develop a strong understanding of the hotels and their respective markets.
  
From a capital structure perspective, including capex planning, major maintenance reserves, brand compliance, and portfolio optimization, have proactive oversight of the execution of the capital plans throughout the year, and monitoring of the capital expenditures for each hotel to include both major renovations and routine capital expenditures.
  
Analyse and track the return on investment for the assets as well as profit improving projects, either implemented or proposed.
  
Integrate sustainability and ESG considerations into asset strategies to future\-proof investments and strengthen brand value
  
Establish and maintain effective working relationship with internal and external constituencies such as property\-level managers, management company representatives, and senior leadership to maximize returns
  
Supervise contract compliance with respect to existing management \& franchise agreements. Review all proposed property\-related contracts for business content as well as potential conflicts with existing obligations
  
Undertake property or portfolio reviews with the objective to improve profitability and recommend asset enhancements
  
Collaborate and support other assignment and colleagues in other functions / departments / offices as required.
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply, you need to be:**  

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline
  
12\-15\+ years working experience in hospitality operations, asset management or relevant consulting, with a proven track record in India and/or the broader Asia Pacific region.
  
Experiences in hotel operation department, finance department or revenue management department would be advantageous
  
Established network within the Indian hospitality investment and ownership community (institutional investors, family offices, private equity, and developers).
  
Task oriented and possesses a track record of meeting deadlines and delivering on goals
  
Detail\-oriented, with excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to work with others to achieve a common goal.
  
Strong analytical and financial analysis skills, as well as comprehensive knowledge of hotel operations.
  
Team player, organized, and strong communication skills.
  
Self\-motivated and ability to multi\-task.
  
Comfort in working independently and as part of a diverse regional team
  
  

As a dedicated Hotels and Hospitality sector specialist you should possess strong analytical, communication and team\-working skills and be comfortable in dealing with people of all cultures and at different levels across Asia Pacific. You should enjoy working in a dynamic, multi\-national environment and be comfortable contributing innovative ideas, insights and suggestions on how to improve the way we conduct, present and communicate our expertise. You should embrace the latest available technology tools as a leverage to source, prepare and deliver up\-to\-date, world\-class data analytics to both internal and external stakeholders.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, we foster an open and collaborative working environment. This environment, combined with the best minds in the business and supported by a platform of cutting\-edge research and new gen technology, ensures that you realise your full potential. If you harbour a passion for learning and are interested in new technologies, JLL will continuously provide you with platforms to enrich your technical domains. It’s no surprise that JLL has been recognized by the Ethisphere Institute as one of the 2025 World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 18th consecutive year.
  
  

Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

About the role
  
As a Domain Consultant – RCGTH, you will make an impact by shaping compelling, insight\-led client propositions across Retail, Consumer Goods, Travel, and Hospitality, translating client priorities into differentiated solution narratives, business cases, proposals, and thought leadership. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with sales, pre\-sales, consulting, solutioning, solution architects, practice leaders, account teams, delivery teams, alliance partners, and clients.

Act as a domain strategist and trusted advisor to sales, business development, consulting, and solutioning teams, researching and synthesizing industry trends, client priorities, market shifts, competitor activity, and emerging technologies across the RCGTH portfolio.
  
Translate client business needs into domain\-led solution themes, capability maps, value propositions, transformation roadmaps, and proposal narratives.
  
Support opportunity qualification and pursuits by developing compelling content for proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, executive presentations, solution storyboards, battle cards, and account\-specific point\-of\-view documents.
  
Shape differentiated go\-to\-market narratives and build reusable RCGTH assets such as industry trend summaries, value maps, use\-case libraries, case studies, reference architectures, and competitive positioning materials.
  
Contribute to practice development through thought leadership, market intelligence, and offering development, and mentor junior business development and pre\-sales associates.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Mumbai. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you must have to be considered
  
10\-15\+ years of experience in domain consulting, business development, pre\-sales, industry advisory, digital transformation, or solution consulting, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  
Strong understanding of Retail, Consumer Goods, Travel, and Hospitality business models, value chains, customer journeys, operating models, and industry\-specific priorities.
  
Proven experience developing proposals, solution narratives, executive presentations, market research outputs, thought leadership, business cases, or go\-to\-market assets.
  
Familiarity with key RCGTH transformation themes and relevant enterprise platforms and technology ecosystems, including CRM, commerce, contact center, data and analytics, AI/GenAI, marketing technology, order management, ERP, and digital experience platforms.
  
Demonstrated ability to convert ambiguous client needs into structured problem statements, value propositions, and outcome\-oriented recommendations while collaborating across cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
  
These will help you succeed
  
An MBA or equivalent consulting experience.
  
Familiarity with CRM and customer engagement technologies such as Salesforce (Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience, Data, and Commerce Cloud, and Agentforce), Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP Customer Experience, Adobe Experience Cloud, and ServiceNow Customer Service Management.
  
Awareness of emerging themes such as hyper\-personalization, omnichannel experience, connected loyalty, intelligent fulfillment, sustainable operations, AI\-enabled workforce, and unified customer intelligence.
  
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to articulate business value, support ROI narratives, and align proposed solutions to client priorities.
  
Excellent research, synthesis, writing, communication, and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior sales, account, consulting, and client stakeholders.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Team Lead - Sales Development
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.


With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.


Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.


**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**

**Role in a Nutshell**

As a Team Lead \- Sales Development at BrowserStack, you will lead a dynamic and growing Sales Development team in a fast\-paced environment. Reporting to the Manager \- Sales Development, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of the sales pipeline by driving top\-of\-funnel activity and nurturing a team of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to ensure they reach their full potential. You’ll be a key contributor to the company’s growth, working in a start\-up\-like atmosphere that encourages innovation and agility, while collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams.


This hands\-on leadership role requires a strategic thinker passionate about coaching and developing high\-performing sales teams, optimizing processes and aligning sales strategies with the company’s overall business goals.


**Desired Experience**

* 7\-10 Years of Sales Development Experience: A proven track record in Sales Development, particularly in SaaS or B2B technology sales. A strong understanding of the sales development lifecycle and experience leading a high\-performing team of SDRs/BDRs.
* Experience Selling Complex Technology Products: Demonstrated ability to understand and sell sophisticated, technology\-driven solutions, and navigate long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
* Leadership Experience: At least 2\+ years of experience managing a team of junior Sales Development Representatives or Business Development Representatives. A natural leader with strong team\-building and mentoring skills.
* Proficiency in Sales Tools \& Platforms: Expertise in prospecting tools and platforms such as Salesforce, Outreach or SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment tools. Strong understanding of lead generation, data cleansing, and prospecting best practices.
* Process\-Oriented \& Analytical Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, troubleshoot challenges and create process improvements. Skilled at using data to inform decisions, evaluate team performance, and optimize strategies.
* Excellent Communication \& Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with team members, stakeholders, and leadership. Comfortable collaborating cross\-functionally and working within a team\-based environment to achieve company goals.
* Highly Motivated \& Results\-Driven: Passionate about driving results, taking ownership, and inspiring a team to meet or exceed sales development targets.

**What Will You Do?**

* **Lead \& Manage the Sales Development Team:** Oversee day\-to\-day operations of the Sales Development team, ensuring high performance, consistent execution, and alignment with business objectives. Foster a collaborative and goal\-oriented environment.
* **Recruit, Train \& Develop:** Hire, train, and coach a team of highly driven and motivated Business Development Representatives (BDRs). Provide ongoing mentorship to improve team members' skills in prospecting, communication, and lead qualification.
* **Optimize Sales Development Processes:** Continuously assess the efficiency and effectiveness of the sales development process. Identify areas of improvement and implement best practices to optimize the team’s performance.
* **Monitor Performance Metrics:** Set and monitor team KPIs, ensuring they meet or exceed lead generation, prospecting, and pipeline contribution expectations. Use data to analyze trends, diagnose bottlenecks, and improve team productivity.
* **Coaching \& Developing Talent:** Provide regular coaching on tools, processes, and strategies. Ensure BDRs stay updated on the latest product features, industry trends, and selling techniques to increase their ability to convert leads into opportunities.
* **Salesforce \& CRM Management:** Ensure accurate documentation of all sales activities, customer interactions, and lead information in Salesforce. Develop and maintain reporting dashboards to track progress.
* **Collaborate with Cross\-functional Teams:** Partner with Marketing, Sales, Product, and other stakeholders to align Sales Development efforts with broader go\-to\-market strategies. Ensure smooth lead handoff between BDRs and Account Executives for seamless prospect engagement.
* **Career Development for BDRs:** Work closely with BDRs to create individualized development plans, ensuring they are on a path toward career growth within the organization. Build a culture of success and advancement within the team.
* **Strategic Prospecting and Territory Management:** Assist in developing new strategies for engaging with high\-potential prospects and territories, refining lead generation tactics, and identifying emerging market opportunities.

**Benefits:**

  

In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:  



  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

**Required education and certifications critical for the role\-** Any Graduate or Post\-Graduate (full time)**Required years of experience –** At least 6 years experience within Strategy Consulting, Management Consulting, Corporate Strategy or a related advisory environment; insurance industry experience preferred. **Do you want to be part of a growth consulting business that helps insurers improve performance by shaping their strategy and bringing it to life?**


Do you excel at leading teams, solving complex business challenges, and delivering meaningful impact for clients?


If so, we'd love to hear from you in connection with this exciting India\-based opportunity, with hybrid working.

 **Aon is in the business of better decisions**
At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. **What the day will look like**  

* Lead project teams to deliver high\-value strategy engagements for insurers, reinsurers and investors across a broad range of strategic topics.
* Manage multiple workstreams and oversee project delivery to ensure high\-quality outcomes, on\-time execution and client satisfaction.
* Structure complex client problems, develop hypotheses and guide teams in generating actionable insights and recommendations.
* Lead market research, financial analysis and data\-driven problem solving to address strategic challenges.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor throughout engagements.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior client audiences, facilitating discussions and managing stakeholder questions.
* Coach, mentor and develop junior team members, supporting their professional growth and performance.
* Contribute to practice development through recruitment, training, knowledge sharing and team initiatives.
* Support the development of go\-to\-market propositions, thought leadership and consulting methodologies.
* Lead and contribute to proposal development, client pitches and other business development activities.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performing team culture and actively contribute to the broader success of the Strategy Consulting team.
* Live the Aon United values.

**How this opportunity is different**  

This is a rare opportunity to join a fast\-growing, globally connected strategy team that is shaping the future of the (re)insurance industry. As a Manager within Aon's Strategy and Technology Group (STG), you will lead high\-impact strategic engagements for some of the industry's most prominent insurers, reinsurers and investors.


Drawing upon Aon's unique data, insights and global expertise, you will help clients address their most critical business challenges while developing trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. You will play a key role in growing and developing our Strategy Consulting practice, contributing to team leadership, business development and capability building.


With direct exposure to senior executives, a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture, and a flexible hybrid working model, this role offers significant opportunities for professional growth, leadership development and industry impact.

*.***Skills and experience that will lead to success**

  

* At least 6 years experience within Strategy Consulting, Management Consulting, Corporate Strategy or a related advisory environment; insurance industry experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of the insurance and/or reinsurance industry and key market trends.
* Demonstrated experience leading consulting engagements and managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical capabilities, with experience structuring and solving complex, unstructured business challenges.
* Experience managing client relationships and engaging effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead, coach and develop high\-performing teams.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, resource management and risk management.
* Advanced experience handling large datasets, building quantitative analyses and producing high\-quality client\-ready outputs in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-level presentation skills.
* Commercial mindset with experience supporting business development, proposal writing and sales activities.
* Intellectual curiosity, business insight and a commitment to continuous learning and development.
* Entrepreneurial and willing to help build the India Strategy Consulting practice.

 **HOW WE SUPPORT OUR COLLEAGUES**


In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.


Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!


Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant and more valued.

description:
**Role: Accounts Executive**

**Employment Type: Permanent, Full\-time** 

**Location: Vile Parle (East), Mumbai**

**Work Mode: Work from Office**

**About the Opportunity**

We are supporting our client, a diversified group with a four\-decade legacy of business excellence, in hiring a dynamic and detail\-oriented Accounts Executive for its premium luxury surfaces and trading business**.** Based out of their corporate office and flagship showroom complex in Vile Parle, the company follows a specialized stock\-and\-trade model dealing in high\-end imported Italian marble.

As an Accounts Executive, you will be responsible for handling general accounting tasks, ensuring the accuracy of financial records, and maintaining seamless transaction records This role sits within the core finance and accounts team, offering direct exposure to corporate bookkeeping, commercial trading cycles, retail billing, and multi\-channel reconciliation.

**Responsibilities**

**Bookkeeping and General Ledger:**

* Handle day\-to\-day accounting entries including recording sales invoices, corporate expenses, bank receipts, payments, and journal entries.
* Maintain accurate books for corporate and trading operations, assisting with month\-end closing, provisions, accruals, and ledger reviews.

**Accounts Payable and Receivable:**

* Support AP and AR workflows by verifying and processing vendor, logistics partner, and international importer/supplier invoices.
* Track high\-value client invoicing, manage customer booking advances, monitor outstanding collections, and handle professional follow\-ups with architectural and interior design partners.

**Inventory and Showroom Tracking:**

* Help organize and categorize daily store expenses, transit vouchers, and cash receipts according to the warehouse and showroom operations.
* Reconcile warehouse delivery documents and dispatch challans directly with corporate inventory entries to track premium material movement accurately.

**Reconciliations and Reporting:**

* Perform regular bank, vendor, walk\-in customer, and commercial ledger reconciliations to resolve discrepancies.
* Help in preparing basic accounting reports, aging sheets, credit cycle records, and basic MIS data.

**Compliance Support:**

* Assist in compiling data and maintaining records to ensure smooth compliance with GST, TDS, and other commercial trading statutory requirements.

**Requirements**

* Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Commerce (B.Com / M.Com) is preferred.
* Experience in general corporate accounting. Exposure to the real estate sector or project accounting is a strong plus but not mandatory.
* Sound knowledge of core accounting concepts (Golden Rules of Accounting, BRS, basic taxation).
* Proficiency in Tally Prime, MS Excel, and standard accounting software.
* High attention to detail, strict adherence to deadlines, integrity in handling financial data, and good professional communication skills.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

**Organization Description**
 Marriott International is the world’s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Senior Manager Digital \& Technology Transformation Rooms Operations, APEC plays a critical role in Marriott’s Digital and Technology Transformation, reporting to Vice President, Operations, South Asia, with a dotted line to Director of Rooms Operations, APEC, based in Mumbai, Bangalore or New Delhi.
   

  

 This role will provide a bridge between current and future processes in Rooms Operations, guiding hotels on the deployment of the new systems and business processes, supporting the guest and associate journey to ensure a smooth transition and cutover. The role will conduct workshops and trainings to transitioning hotels, ensuring that property teams are fully prepared to successfully operate the new systems from Day 1\.
   

  

 To accomplish this, the Senior Manager Digital \& Technology Transformation Rooms Operations, APEC will develop subject matter expertise covering the end\-to\-end systems and processes for the Associates to deliver great guest experiences, including Opera Cloud PMS, EMPOWER GXP, SPOG, and ARA and Loyalty Operations, and to use the knowledge to support hotel teams across APEC. The successful candidate is required to possess a deep knowledge of existing operations within APEC and the systems that support it, including Opera PMS, MARSHA, EMPOWER GXP, EMPOWER ResApp, and the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program. Furthermore, the role will understand the shift from MARSHA to Amadeus Central Reservation System (ACRS), and the effects of the change on Rooms tasks, including guaranteed attributes, non\-room products, etc.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Testing and Product Validation: Contribute to end\-to\-end business process validation testing for the discipline, collaborating with relevant stakeholders in DGE, Rooms Operations, and Loyalty Operations disciplines in APEC
* End\-to\-End Deployment Validation:
* Lead validation of deployment resources, Land\-It tasks, and other items to ensure deployment readiness
* Align required changes with relevant stakeholders
* Digital Learning Path: Partner with Learning and Development (L\&D) to ensure property associates receive the training assignments, resources, and system accesses required for their particular roles.
* Workshop Facilitation \& Training: Lead interactive operations workshops and webinars (virtual and/or in\-person) for property teams to facilitate training, share best practices, and address common challenges
* Property Support: Act as the SME for property Operations teams, providing timely responses to property questions and triaging challenges raised by properties
* Deployment Support
* Work closely with Implementation Managers (IMs) during the deployment, focusing on critical task validation and knowledge transfer with property and discipline teams during the Prepare and Ready phases
* Assist with Command Center operations during the Launch phase, ensuring operational queries and support tickets are resolved promptly
* Continue supporting IMs and discipline teams throughout the Stabilization phase, helping properties adapt to new business processes and tools
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management
* Act as a trusted advisor to property operators and deployment teams.
* Communicate complex system concepts in clear, actionable terms.
* Collaboration across other SMEs (including Revenue, Reservations, Group, Sales, Events, Finance, and IT) is essential.
* Gather feedback from early adopters and share insights to improve future workshops and deployment processes.
* Foster a collaborative, supportive learning environment.
* Materials \& Continuous Improvement
* Utilize and continuously refine workshop facilitation materials, participant guides, and job aids.
* Contribute to the development of new learning content and process documentation.


**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
* Technical \& Functional Expertise
+ Deep knowledge of existing operations within APEC and the systems that support it, including Opera PMS, MARSHA, EMPOWER: GXP, EMPOWER: RES, and the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program.
+ Ability to quickly learn and build expertise in the new systems and processes that create the entire end\-to\-end experience for Rooms associates, including Opera Cloud PMS, SPOG, and ARA

* Change Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement
+ Proven ability to lead hotels and operations teams through complex system and process changes, articulating what is changing and what is staying the same.
+ Skilled in training, stakeholder communication, and change enablement strategies.
+ Strong influencing skills with the ability to align cross functional teams across disciplines.

* Problem\-Solving \& Decision\-Making
+ Analytical thinker with strong root cause analysis skills and structured risk mitigation approach.
+ Comfortable operating in fast paced, ambiguous environments.
+ Strong judgment to prioritize effectively and manage competing demands.

* Collaboration \& Cross\-Functional Partnership
+ Ability to build strong relationships across regional teams and hotel teams.
+ Comfortable bridging the gap between business requirements, product design, and technical stakeholders.
+ Collaborative mindset focused on shared outcomes and continuous improvement.

* Communication \& Facilitation
+ Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills tailored to both operational and executive audiences.
+ Ability to simplify complex concepts and provide clear direction during implementation and support phases.
+ Confident facilitator of workshops, discussions, and rapid problem solving sessions.

* Adaptability \& Resilience
+ Effective in dynamic deployment environments with competing priorities.
+ Resilient under pressure, maintaining a positive, proactive approach.
+ Strong sense of ownership and drive for operational excellence.


**Required Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of progressive experience in hotel operations, with at least 3 years in a leadership or SME role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering training or workshops to adult learners.
* Deep knowledge of existing PMS, GXP, CRS, and other operational systems.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to travel as needed for workshop delivery.


**Preferred Skills \& Attributes**
* Experience with large\-scale system deployments or property conversions.
* Experience in adult learning, instructional design, or facilitation.
* Change management or project management credentials.
* Collaborative, adaptable, and solutions\-oriented mindset.


**Tools \& Resources Used**
* Workshop Facilitation Materials (slide decks, participant guides, activity sheets).
* Opera Cloud
* SPOG
* EMPOWER: GXP
* EMPOWER: RES
* ARA
* JIRA
* ServiceNow/Power of M ticketing for configuration support.
* Product Catalog and Land\-It task management systems

description:
***Area Sales Manager – Poultry Additives***

**Company:** Nright Nutrition **Locations :** Pune \| Karnal \| Jabalpur \| Lucknow **Experience Required:** 5\+ years **Industry:** Animal Health / Poultry Nutrition \& Additives **Employment Type:** Full\-Time

***About Us:***

Nright Solutions is a manufacturer of poultry feed and feed additives, producing medicated and nutritional products that are mixed into poultry feed to support flock health and performance. Our product range includes **Butyrite\-N70, Right\-D3, Rmulin10,** and **Odorite HF**, among others.

***About the Role:***

We are looking for an experienced **Area Sales Manager** to drive field sales of our poultry additive products across an assigned territory. This is a field\-intensive role \- the candidate will work directly with poultry farms, hatcheries, feed mills, and related businesses to promote and sell our products. A strong technical understanding of the products is essential, as the role requires explaining product usage, benefits, and dosage to farm owners, veterinarians, and other stakeholders in the field.

***Key Responsibilities:***

* Drive field sales of poultry additive products (Butyrite\-N70, Right\-D3, Rmulin10, Odorite HF, and others) within the assigned area
* Visit poultry farms, hatcheries, feed mills, and distributors regularly to generate and close sales
* Build and maintain strong relationships with farm owners, poultry veterinarians, and channel partners
* Develop in\-depth product knowledge and clearly explain product composition, benefits, dosage, and usage to customers
* Identify new business opportunities and onboard new customers/dealers in the territory
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for the assigned area
* Handle customer queries and provide after\-sales support and guidance on product usage
* Monitor competitor products and market trends, and report insights to the management
* Coordinate with the sales and marketing team for promotional activities, farmer meetings, and product demonstrations
* Maintain accurate records of visits, sales, and customer feedback, and submit regular reports

***Requirements:***

* Minimum 5 years of field sales experience, preferably in poultry feed, feed additives, animal health, or veterinary pharma products
* Sound knowledge of poultry farming practices and feed/additive usage
* Any graduate (Bachelor's degree in any discipline); a background in Veterinary Science, Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, or Life Sciences is a plus but not mandatory
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical product information to farmers and dealers
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory for field visits
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven, and comfortable working independently in the field
* Valid driving license and own vehicle preferred

***What We Offer:***

* Competitive salary \+ performance\-based incentives
* Travel and conveyance allowance
* Opportunity to work with a growing player in the poultry additives industry
* Career growth opportunities within the organization

**Interested candidates may apply with their updated resume.**

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

**Job Title:** Accounts Payable Specialist  
**Department:** Finance / Accounting

Position Summary

We are seeking a precise and reliable Accounts Payable Specialist to manage our vendor payments, invoice processing, and financial disbursement workflow. In this role, you will maintain strong vendor relationships, conduct 3\-way matching, ensure proper GL coding, and optimize cash outflows while enforcing internal financial controls.

* Receive, review, and enter vendor invoices, bills, and check requests with high accuracy.
* Perform 3\-way matching by verifying invoices against Purchase Orders (POs) and receiving documents.
* Route invoices to appropriate department managers for review and sign\-off.
* Assign accurate general ledger (GL) account codes and cost centres to all transactions.

Disbursements \& Cash Flow Management

* Schedule, prepare, and execute payment runs via ACH, wire transfers, check, or corporate credit card.
* Take advantage of early payment discounts when applicable while optimizing payment timing.
* Maintain vendor payment schedules and manage payment hold requests when disputes arise.

Vendor Management \& Communication

* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date vendor profiles, including W\-9 forms, bank payment details, and tax IDs.
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendor inquiries regarding payment status and invoice discrepancies.
* Reconcile monthly vendor statements against internal accounting records to resolve missing bills.

Expense Reporting \& Compliance

* Review and audit employee expense reports for policy compliance and proper receipts.
* Assist in year\-end 1099/1096 tax form preparation and distribution.
* Support month\-end closing processes, including month\-end AP accruals and reconciliation of AP sub\-ledger to the general ledger.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration preferred.

**Experience:** 2–4 years of experience in accounts payable, general bookkeeping, or accounting.

**Software Proficiency:**

* Proficiency in accounting ERP platforms (SAP \& Tally)
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (data filtering, formulas, reconciliation sheets).

**Core Competencies:**

* High level of attention to detail and accuracy to prevent duplicate payments or fraud.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills to consistently meet payment deadlines.
* Professional communication skills for effective vendor coordination and internal communication.

* Cell phone reimbursement

**Specialise Products Private Limited** is a trusted Indian Original Design Manufacturer (ODM) offering end\-to\-end conceptualization, design, and manufacturing of customised machines for Industry and Research applications. With over 25\+ years of core expertise in Lasers, Quantum Optics, Fiber Optics, Spectroscopy, High\-Energy Physics, and OptoElectronics, we have successfully supplied and executed projects for renowned institutions like IITs, NITs, IISERs, IIITs, Central Universities, Government R\&D labs, and Private Industry. In addition to custom\-built solutions, we are also actively involved in the Sales and Distribution of Principal Products from global OEMs and act as System Integrators for our customers, offering complete technical solutions under one roof. Our collaborations with esteemed Government labs such as **DRDO, ISRO, DAE, IITs and CSIR** further solidify our position as a leading player in the industry.

**Role Overview :**

We are looking for a dynamic and technically sound Sales Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate should possess a blend of technical understanding and business development acumen to promote and sell our range of Customised Machines and Principal Products. The role involves customer engagement, technical understanding, solution selling, and long\-term relationship management—primarily in the educational, institutional, and R\&D sectors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in Government labs, Academic Institutes, and Industry.
* Promote and sell a portfolio of customized machines (e.g., laser systems, 3D printers, engraving machines) and principal products sourced from international partners.
* Serve as a technical advisor to customers – understanding application needs and recommending suitable solutions.
* Conduct technical presentations, demonstrations, and product training for customers.
* Work closely with the internal design to offer custom solutions when standard products do not meet customer requirements.
* Prepare quotations, technical proposals, and follow through on the complete sales cycle.
* Participate in tenders, exhibitions, trade shows, and other promotional activities.
* Maintain strong customer relationships for repeat business and service support.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and competitors' offerings.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* B.E. or B.Tech/ B.Sc. (Electronics, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Physics, or similar fields).
* Ability to understand and explain complex technical systems and applications.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer relationship skills.
* Experience working with Government procurement processes, technical tenders, and institutional clients is a strong plus.
* Willingness to travel regularly for client visits, demos, and exhibitions.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Business Development Associate
description:
We are looking for a **Business Development Executive** with a strong focus on lead generation and prospecting. The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential clients, building a strong sales pipeline, initiating conversations, qualifying prospects, and generating new business opportunities.

The role will involve extensive use of Pipedrive CRM to manage prospect databases, track outreach, schedule follow\-ups, monitor the sales pipeline, and maintain accurate records of all business development activities.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, target\-driven, confident in communication, and comfortable with cold calling, LinkedIn outreach, email outreach, online research, networking, exhibitions, and industry events.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research and identify potential B2B clients and decision\-makers across relevant industries.
* Generate new leads through cold calling, LinkedIn, email outreach, online research, referrals, databases, exhibitions, trade shows, networking events, and other relevant channels.
* Build and continuously expand a database of prospective clients.
* Identify the right decision\-makers, including business owners, founders, marketing heads, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Make outbound calls and initiate conversations with prospective clients.
* Conduct cold outreach through phone calls, emails, LinkedIn messages, and other channels.
* Attend industry exhibitions, trade shows, conferences, networking events, and business events to identify and connect with potential clients.
* Actively network with attendees, exhibitors, and decision\-makers to generate new business leads.
* Collect and maintain relevant prospect information and ensure all leads generated through events are added to Pipedrive CRM.
* Follow up with leads and contacts generated through exhibitions and events to convert them into qualified opportunities.
* Understand the prospect's business, requirements, challenges, and potential need for digital marketing services.
* Qualify leads based on business requirement, budget, decision\-making authority, and timeline.
* Maintain a consistent daily/weekly lead\-generation and outreach target.
* Follow up with prospects at regular intervals to convert cold prospects into qualified leads.
* Re\-engage with old, inactive, and previously contacted leads to generate new opportunities.
* Schedule meetings with qualified prospects for the sales/strategy team.
* Maintain complete and accurate lead information in Pipedrive CRM.
* Add new prospects, contacts, organizations, notes, activities, and follow\-ups to Pipedrive.
* Ensure every lead is assigned the correct stage and has a clear next action.
* Track all calls, emails, LinkedIn interactions, event interactions, follow\-ups, and responses in Pipedrive.
* Regularly monitor the pipeline and ensure there are no unattended or missed follow\-ups.
* Maintain proper CRM hygiene and ensure data is updated on a daily basis.
* Prepare regular reports on leads generated, outreach completed, qualified leads, meetings scheduled, and pipeline generated.
* Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to identify new target segments and lead\-generation opportunities.

**Requirements:**  
**Pipedrive CRM Responsibilities**

* Maintain a structured and updated prospect database in Pipedrive.
* Add and categorize new leads and prospects.
* Update lead status, deal stages, contact details, and communication history.
* Schedule and manage follow\-up activities and reminders.
* Record call outcomes, email responses, event interactions, requirements, and prospect information.
* Track prospects from initial outreach → qualification → meeting → opportunity → conversion.
* Identify inactive leads and take proactive steps to revive them.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date sales pipeline reports.
* Ensure all business development activities are properly recorded in Pipedrive.

**Lead Generation \& Exhibition Expectations**

The candidate will be expected to:

* Consistently generate new prospects every day through both online and offline channels.
* Conduct a high volume of outbound calls and outreach activities.
* Build and maintain a qualified prospect database.
* Attend relevant exhibitions, trade shows, conferences, and networking events as required.
* Proactively approach potential clients and decision\-makers at industry events.
* Build relationships with prospects and identify potential business requirements.
* Follow up with all relevant contacts collected through exhibitions and events.
* Identify new industries, companies, and market segments for business opportunities.
* Convert cold prospects and event contacts into qualified leads and scheduled meetings.
* Maintain a healthy and active sales pipeline.
* Achieve defined monthly lead\-generation and meeting targets.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in Business Development, Lead Generation, Inside Sales, Telesales, or B2B Sales.
* Experience with Pipedrive CRM is preferred.
* Strong experience in cold calling and outbound lead generation.
* Comfortable attending exhibitions, trade shows, conferences, and networking events.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident in speaking with business owners and senior decision\-makers.
* Strong research and prospecting skills.
* Ability to identify and qualify potential business opportunities.
* Persistent and comfortable with regular follow\-ups and handling rejection.
* Highly organized and disciplined with CRM updates.
* Target\-oriented with a strong focus on achieving lead and meeting\-generation goals.
* Willingness to travel locally for exhibitions, meetings, and business development activities.
* Experience in digital marketing, advertising, SaaS, IT, or other B2B services will be an advantage.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Reporting to:** Prakash Dhirwani, Founder  
**Role:** Founder’s Office / Strategic Assistant / Chief of Staff

**About iLabkart**

iLabkart was founded in 2020 by **Prakash Dhirwani**, an entrepreneur with a track record of building and successfully exiting businesses in B2B distribution of clinical diagnostics and life\-sciences products.

Over the last six years, iLabkart has evolved into a multi\-SBU business spanning three core areas:

**Fitness** — Importing and distributing premium global fitness brands including Shua, Panatta, Booty Builder, Eleiko, TRX, Pulse Fitness, Torque Fitness and other world\-class equipment brands.

**Medical** — Representing established international brands including Beckman Coulter, Vivere Imaging, Bodystat UK and Tanita.

**Recovery \& Wellness** — A newer and strategically important direction for the company through its own brand, **ICONIQ Wellness**. ICONIQ currently works with OEM partners while building a technology platform that will eventually extend into the diagnostics side of wellness.

One of iLabkart’s strongest competitive advantages is its access to **premium and luxury gym networks**, creating a powerful point\-of\-sale and distribution ecosystem for new products and brands.

The next phase of the company is about **scaling ICONIQ Wellness, continuously identifying new international partnerships, and building the systems required to keep the existing business strong while pursuing new opportunities.**

**The Role**

This is **not a traditional Chief of Staff position.**

We are looking for someone who can become an extension of the Founder — someone who can understand the business, think independently, represent him when required, challenge his thinking, and make sure important things actually get done.

The Founder is involved in multiple businesses, partnerships, product categories and strategic initiatives simultaneously. The Chief of Staff job is to help him **think better, move faster and remain focused on the highest\-value opportunities.**

**What You Will Actually Do**

**1\. Act as the Founder’s extension**

Understand what the Founder is trying to accomplish and help convert his ideas into actions.

* Maintain a clear view of the Founder’s priorities, commitments and pending decisions.
* Follow up with internal teams and external stakeholders without waiting to be instructed repeatedly.
* Ensure important actions discussed in meetings are actually completed.
* Prepare the Founder for important meetings with relevant background, numbers, people and talking points.
* Keep track of strategic initiatives across Fitness, Medical and ICONIQ.
* Bring issues to the Founder early rather than allowing them to become problems.

**2\. Represent the Founder**

You will occasionally attend meetings on behalf of the Founder and act as his representative.

This could include meetings with:

* International manufacturers and potential brand partners
* Existing principals and distributors
* Luxury gym chains and key customers
* Investors and financial partners
* Technology companies
* OEM manufacturers
* Architects, consultants and project partners
* Potential strategic partners

You must be comfortable sitting across the table from senior executives and entrepreneurs and conducting yourself with confidence and maturity.

**3\. Find the next opportunity**

A major part of this role is **business development through intelligence and curiosity.**

The Founder is constantly looking for:

* New international brands to bring to India
* New technologies in fitness, medical diagnostics and recovery
* Potential OEM relationships for ICONIQ
* Products that can be introduced through iLabkart's existing gym network
* New categories adjacent to wellness and diagnostics
* International companies looking for an India partner
* Large projects where iLabkart / ICONIQ can provide a complete turnkey solution

You will be expected to continuously research the market and bring opportunities to the Founder.

**4\. Help build ICONIQ Wellness**

ICONIQ is one of the most important strategic growth opportunities for the company.

You will work closely with the Founder on areas such as:

* New product identification
* OEM identification and evaluation
* Competitor research
* International wellness trends
* Product positioning
* Potential partnerships
* New distribution channels
* Luxury gym opportunities
* Recovery centre concepts
* Technology and app initiatives
* Diagnostics and wellness integration
* New business models

You should be someone who gets genuinely excited by **building something that does not yet exist.**

**5\. Track the business — don't just track the Founder**

The Chief of Staff should have a strong understanding of the company's key numbers and operating metrics.

You may be responsible for maintaining and reviewing dashboards covering areas such as:

* Sales
* Gross margins
* Collections
* Inventory
* Sales pipeline
* Brand\-wise performance
* New customer acquisition
* Key projects
* Import pipeline
* ICONIQ sales and growth
* Major outstanding actions
* Business development opportunities

**6\. Drive execution**

The Founder will generate ideas faster than any individual can execute them.

Your job is to make sure good ideas don't disappear.

You will:

* Maintain action trackers
* Assign and follow up on responsibilities
* Track deadlines
* Coordinate between departments
* Follow up with vendors and partners
* Escalate delays
* Prepare weekly status updates
* Ensure important initiatives continue moving

You should be comfortable being persistent.

**What We Are Looking For**

The ideal person will have:

**Entrepreneurial thinking**

**Commercial understanding**

**Excellent communication**

**High ownership**

**High energy and willingness to work hard**

**Compensation \& Growth**

This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the business, not simply take a job. The right candidate will have the opportunity to build a long\-term association with the Founder and iLabkart, with **strong earning potential that increases with the value and impact they create for the business**. As the company grows and the individual takes on greater responsibility, ownership and strategic contribution, the compensation and rewards will reflect that journey. **If you are exceptional and create exceptional value, you should expect to be rewarded accordingly.**

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people\-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. You’ll own a territory of Indian organisations with **1,000–5,000 employees**, managing complex HR technology sales opportunities, engaging executive stakeholders and helping customers move from manual, fragmented or legacy processes to modern, connected and data\-driven workforce solutions.
