Selling HR technology in India requires more than product knowledge. It requires the ability to understand how organisations are scaling, where HR processes are becoming complex, and how leaders think about compliance, productivity, employee experience and ROI.


You’ll work with fast\-growing and established businesses—including promoter\-led companies, GCCs and organisations with distributed or frontline workforces—helping them improve payroll accuracy, workforce visibility, manager effectiveness and employee experience.

You’ll own the entire customer journey.

* Run consultative discovery with HR, Finance, Operations and Executive stakeholders.

* Work with Solution Consultants, Marketing, Business Development teams, partners and ecosystem influencers to build market presence and progress opportunities.
* Consistently exceed your sales targets.

**Who We’re Looking For**


This role is ideal for someone who’s already successful and wants to accelerate their career.


You’ll probably have:


* 5\+ years of success in SaaS sales or running your own successful business.
* A track record of exceeding quota.
* Strong outbound prospecting skills.
* The ability to open doors in greenfield accounts and create urgency where HR transformation may not yet be budgeted.
* Experience running full sales cycles.
* Confidence presenting to senior decision\-makers.
* A consultative approach to selling.
* Comfort navigating price\-sensitive, ROI\-driven buying environments with multiple business and technology stakeholders.
* A genuine desire to continue learning and growing.
* Experience managing consultative SaaS sales cycles.
* Exposure to industries with large, distributed or frontline workforces—such as manufacturing, retail, healthcare, hospitality, logistics, BFSI, IT/ITES or GCCs—would be an advantage.
* Experience selling HR technology, payroll, Workforce Management, HCM, ERP, employee experience platforms or other enterprise SaaS solutions will be highly valued.

You don’t need Enterprise Sales experience.


You do need the ambition to get there.


**Why Sales Professionals Stay at UKG**


We believe great salespeople want more than a good commission plan.


They want to keep growing.


At UKG you’ll benefit from:


* A recognised global brand that opens doors.
* Award\-winning HCM and Workforce Management solutions.
* World\-class sales enablement and coaching.
* Genuine career pathways into Enterprise, Strategic and Global Account sales.
* High\-performing leaders who invest in your development.

Your Next Chapter Starts Here


If you’re ready to sell bigger deals, work with larger customers and build a career with one of the world’s leading SaaS companies, we’d love to meet you.


Join UKG and help organisations become great places to work—while building a career you’ll be proud of.

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end\-to\-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world's critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

**The Position**
----------------



India is one of the fastest\-growing and most strategically important cybersecurity markets globally, and a critical pillar of OPSWAT's growth strategy.



We are looking for a Regional Sales Director, India West/Enterprise to lead and accelerate OPSWAT's sales organization and market growth in India.



This is a sales leadership opportunity for an experienced, hands\-on cybersecurity sales leader who can build and run a lean, high\-performing sales team, develop strategic customer and partner relationships, and drive significant revenue growth across private sector enterprise markets.



The role will involve working closely with the VP of APJ Sales, global leadership, and cross\-functional teams.


**Team \& Reporting**
---------------------


* Leads a growing sales team of approx. 3\-4 people Regional Sales Managers/Account Executives working closely with Solution Engineer, and Channel/Partner functions.
* Reports to the VP of APJ Sales.
* Based in Mumbai, India, with regular travel across India.

**What You Will Be Doing**
--------------------------


* Develop and execute the India West/Enterprise GTM and sales strategy to achieve revenue targets.
* Personally engage in and help close strategic, high\-value opportunities alongside the team.
* Drive growth across private sector enterprise customers including BFSI, Telecom, Manufacturing and other critical infrastructure sectors.
* Build strategic relationships with key customers and executive stakeholders.
* Identify new market opportunities and expand OPSWAT's presence across India.
* Recruit, coach, and develop a small, high\-performing sales team.
* Establish a strong sales operating cadence and partner with HR and global leadership to build and retain top talent.
* Build strategic relationships with distributors, system integrators, MSSPs, and technology partners.
* Represent OPSWAT at key industry and events and serve as executive sponsor for strategic opportunities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (marketing, product, customer success) to drive business growth.
* Personally lead the conglomerates strategy and execution, owning the associated quota personally.

**What We Need From You**
-------------------------


* 20\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, IT, networking, or related technology sales, including direct, hands\-on selling.
* Proven experience leading small, high\-performing sales teams in India.
* Proven track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets and driving multimillion\-dollar business growth.
* Strong experience selling to enterprise customers, with exposure to public sector opportunities considered an advantage.
* Established relationships across private sector enterprise customers including BFSI, Telecom, Manufacturing and other critical infrastructure sectors.

* Strong understanding of the Indian cybersecurity market.

* Establish a strong and predictable India Enterprise Sales organization.
* Build a healthy pipeline and accelerate revenue growth.

* Strengthen OPSWAT's partner ecosystem and market presence.
* Build a scalable foundation for the continued growth of the India enterprise business.

This is an opportunity to build and shape OPSWAT's Enterprise India business at a critical stage of growth.



You will have the autonomy to build a lean, high\-performing sales team, influence India market strategy, work with global leaders, and help establish OPSWAT as a leading cybersecurity partner across private sector enterprise market and critical infrastructure.

About the Role  
We are looking for an experienced Execution Head to lead the Mumbai Execution Department and manage  
multiple luxury residential turnkey interior projects. The candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end project  
delivery, billing, estimation, execution, quality, cost control, snagging, desnagging and final handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage the complete Mumbai Execution Department.

* Review BOQs, drawings, specifications, estimates and project budgets before execution.
* Manage project estimation, quantity calculations, costing and variation/additional work estimates.
* Monitor project billing, contractor bills, client billing, measurements and certifications in coordination

with Accounts.

* Ensure projects are delivered within approved timeline, budget, scope and quality standards.
* Manage Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, contractors and vendors.
* Monitor civil, MEP, carpentry, modular furniture, false ceiling, flooring, painting, lighting and finishing

works.

* Ensure execution is as per approved drawings, BOQs and specifications.
* Conduct regular site inspections and quality checks.
* Minimize rework, material wastage and execution errors.
* Manage contractor performance, manpower deployment, rates and commercial negotiations.
* Coordinate with Design, Purchase, Accounts, Sales and Billing teams.
* Identify project risks, delays and cost overruns and take corrective action.
* Manage snagging and desnagging activities and ensure timely closure of all defects.
* Conduct pre\-handover inspections and ensure the project is ready for client handover.
* Ensure completion of handover documents, warranties, final measurements and closing

documentation.

* Handle client escalations related to execution, quality, billing and timelines.
* Prepare regular MIS and project performance reports for management.

**Key KPIs**

* On\-time project completion and milestone achievement
* Execution cost vs. approved budget
* Estimation and billing accuracy
* Contractor bill verification and timely certification
* Material wastage and labour productivity
* Quality and rework percentage
* Snagging/desnagging closure time
* Contractor and team productivity
* Client escalations and resolution time
* Project profitability
* Handover and post\-handover satisfaction

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, Construction

Management or related field.

* 10–15 years of experience in interior execution/project management.
* 5\+ years in a senior execution leadership role preferred.
* Strong experience in luxury residential turnkey interiors.
* Strong knowledge of execution, estimation, billing, BOQ, costing, civil, MEP, carpentry, modular

furniture and finishing works.

* Proven experience managing multiple high\-value projects and large execution teams.
* Strong contractor management, commercial, negotiation and client\-handling skills.

**Ideal Candidate**  
A hands\-on execution leader capable of independently managing:  
Estimation → Planning → Billing → Team → Contractors → Execution → Quality → Snagging → Desnagging → Cost  
Control → Client Coordination → Final Handover

Experience with luxury interior companies, turnkey firms, premium developers, architecture/design firms or  
construction/project management companies will be preferred.

Key Requirement: Strong hands\-on experience in luxury residential interior execution in Mumbai, with  
complete ownership of project execution, estimation, billing, quality, snagging, desnagging and final delivery.

title: Sales Operations Lead
description:
**About Us:**

  


AppZen is the leader in autonomous spend\-to\-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows to read, understand, and make real\-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises, including one\-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen’s invoice, expense, and card transaction solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their businesses. To learn more, visit us at www.appzen.com.

  

**Position Summary**
====================



The Sales Operations Lead will be responsible for driving the day\-to\-day operational health and efficiency of Salesforce across the Go\-To\-Market (GTM) organization. Primary focus areas include optimizing and executing the end\-to\-end deal closing process, maintaining high data hygiene standards, providing core Salesforce administration support, overseeing revenue reporting infrastructure, and leveraging AI technologies to automate recurring operational workflows.

  


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**Deal Closing \& Revenue Operations**
--------------------------------------


* Manage end\-to\-end deal closure operations for ARR\-based accounts, including opportunity processing, closed\-won stage transitions, order intake, and post\-sale account handoffs.
* Oversee commercial documentation lifecycle within Salesforce, including Statements of Work (SOWs), contracts, amendments, and order forms.
* Streamline and formalize the deal closing framework to minimize manual effort and reduce latency between opportunity CloseDate and processing execution.
* Lead recurring revenue operations and renewal management, overseeing quoting, contract modifications, pricing adjustments, and stakeholder alignment.
* Track client offboarding, contract terminations, and ARR adjustments in coordination with the Recurring Revenue team to ensure accurate financial alignment.
* Monitor and resolve pending or aged requests in the Deal Desk and Sales Ops queues, maintaining SLA targets and issue resolution efficiency.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and executive approvers to resolve deal friction and accelerate approval timelines.

**Data Management \& Hygiene**
------------------------------


* Maintain high data integrity standard across Salesforce Accounts, Opportunities, Contacts, and Activities, executing data enrichment, deduplication, and record merging.
* Execute ongoing maintenance and data corrections for Account and Opportunity records.
* Support territory planning, account segmentation, ownership rules, and sales coverage strategies to ensure CRM structure mirrors strategic business goals.

**Salesforce Administration \& Reporting**
------------------------------------------


* Execute foundational Salesforce administrative tasks, including record maintenance, standard configuration, field updates, and user issue resolution.
* Maintain and refine standard Salesforce reporting structures and executive dashboards across key metrics: pipeline health, ARR growth, renewals, and account coverage.
* Facilitate revenue reconciliation between sales data and accounting records, producing regular operational analytics for GTM leadership.
* Provide data\-driven insights and reporting assets to support business reviews and executive planning.

**Process Automation \& Continuous Improvement**
------------------------------------------------


* Deploy AI tools, agents, and automated workflows to reduce manual overhead in routine Sales Ops and deal processing tasks.
* Proactively identify process bottlenecks across Revenue Operations and introduce scalable automation solutions.
* Collaborate with GTM Ops to evaluate, pilot, and expand AI\-driven operational workflows.

  



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Governance**
-------------------------------------------------


* Lead operational improvement projects from initiation to completion, including business requirements gathering, documentation, rollouts, and change management.
* Establish standard documentation, data dictionaries, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and glossaries for GTM processes.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for internal Sales Operations inquiries, ensuring proper triage, escalation, and stakeholder communication.

  



**Qualifications \& Requirements**
==================================


* Demonstrated experience managing Lead\-to\-Cash operations in Salesforce, with a strong background in pipeline maintenance or process optimization.
* Proficiency in Salesforce administration; Salesforce Certified Administrator credentials preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of GTM funnel dynamics (top, middle, and bottom funnel management).

  



* High data quality standards and experience executing large\-scale record maintenance across Accounts, Opportunities, and Contacts.
* Practical experience or strong aptitude for AI\-driven workflow automation tools, software agents, and operational scripting.
* Proven ability to drive structure, clarity, and standardized controls in fast\-paced or unstructured operational environments.
* Familiarity with Jira, Salesforce CRM platform, and revenue technology stacks.

**About us**

**Ashwamedh Spaces** is a Pune redevelopment specialist. We have delivered every project we have taken up since 2013 and currently have seven active sites across Kothrud, Erandwane and Sinhagad Road. Our buyers are end\-users and upgraders in the ₹1\.2–2\.25 Cr ticket range. We are a \~20\-person company, so this role has direct visibility with the founders.

**What the role is**

Channel partners are central to how we sell, and this role owns that relationship day to day. You run the channel partner desk: you stay on the phone with brokers and CP firms across West Pune, keep our projects at the top of their pile, chase every lead they refer, and close the loop back to them on what happened. Buyer follow\-ups are the second half of the role.

You are measured on **site visits that actually happen and CPs who stay active**, not on calls dialled.

**What you will do**

**Channel partners (primary)**

* Work a live CP database and call every empanelled partner on a fixed weekly cycle, whether or not they have a lead for us.
* Circulate current inventory, pricing and possession status by call and WhatsApp, and confirm it has landed.
* Chase referred leads end to end: acknowledge, call the buyer, report the outcome back to the CP the same day.
* Track CP performance and coordinate brokerage documentation and payment status with the accounts team.
* Cold\-call new brokers and CP firms across West Pune for empanelment, and coordinate broker meets and site walkthroughs.

**Buyers (secondary)**

* Call every new enquiry within 15 minutes and qualify on budget, configuration, possession timeline, funding route and locality.
* Fix site visits and protect them\- confirmation the previous evening, reminder on the day, re\-fix every no\-show.
* Run a written follow\-up cadence on undecided buyers and re\-engage the old database.
* Every lead and CP dispositioned in the CRM the same day, with next action and date.

**What you must have**

* 1–3 years in telecalling, inside sales or pre\-sales. Real estate experience preferred; channel partner or broker\-facing experience is what we are really looking for.
* **Fluent Marathi,** non\-negotiable. Plus Hindi, and English sufficient for written follow\-ups.
* The temperament to build a relationship over the phone with someone who owes you nothing. CPs work with whoever treats them best; that will be you.
* Comfort with a CRM, Excel and WhatsApp Business. You will be asked to demonstrate this, not just claim it.
* Willingness to work weekends. Saturdays and Sundays are when buyers visit; that is when we work. The week\-off is Monday.

**Nice to have**

* An existing broker network in West Pune.
* Experience with society redevelopment projects, where the buyer set includes existing members as well as open\-market purchasers.

* Internet reimbursement

We empower enterprises globally through intelligent, creative, and insightful services for data integration, data analytics and data visualization.

At Hoonartek, we work to ensure that our customers, partners and employees all benefit from our unstinting commitment to delivery, quality and value. Hoonartek is increasingly the choice for customers seeking a trusted partner of vision, value and integrity

Define, Design and Deliver (D3\) is our in\-house delivery philosophy. It’s culled from agile and rapid methodologies and focused on ‘just enough design’. We embrace this philosophy in everything we do, leading to numerous client success stories and indeed to our own success.

Job Description

Location
  
  

Pune, India — in\-office, five days a week
  
  

Reports To
  
  

CEO
  
  

Experience
  
  

6–10 years
  
  

Joining
  
  

Immediate preferred
  
  

Engagement
  
  

Shadow the CEO. No remote. No hybrid.
  
  

The Role
  
  

Hoonartek is at an inflection point — a proprietary product (ClearView) in market, a 1,000\-person delivery engine scaling across India, US and APAC, and a CEO office that needs a second brain.
  
  

The Chief of Staff \& Head of Strategy Operations will sit beside the CEO every day, own the highest\-leverage workstreams in the company, and be trusted with information that does not leave the room. This is a senior leadership role (not EA or coordinate) that entails independent thinking, analysis, planning and execution acting as a surrogate for CEO.
  
  

If you have ever wanted to understand how a high\-growth technology company is built — from strategic partnerships to sales pipeline governance to org restructuring — this is the role. You will see all of it. You will be expected to act on most of it.
  
  

What You Will Own
  
  

Sales Productivity \& Revenue Operations
  
  

– Own pipeline governance — weekly deal reviews, stage hygiene, forecast integrity
  
  

**– Drive SalesOps discipline:** CRM ownership, win/loss tracking, territory hygiene
  
  

– Work directly with the sales leadership to ensure post\-event and BD leads are tracked to closure
  
  

Strategic Projects
  
  

– Define, structure, and manage cross\-functional strategic projects — cost optimisation, org efficiency, new market entry
  
  

**– Build the CEO's operating rhythm:** weekly reviews, action logs, closure tracking
  
  

– Own competitive intelligence — systematic tracking of peers and market development
  
  

Strategic Finance \& External Engagements
  
  

– Manage and maintain structured documentation repositories for external engagements — always organised and audit\-ready
  
  

– Coordinate with external advisors and senior stakeholders on document requests, follow\-ups, and engagement timelines
  
  

– Maintain and update executive decks and briefing materials as the business evolves – Prepare the CEO for every external interaction with sharp, concise briefing notes
  
  

Board \& Executive Governance (Working with board and senior executives)
  
  

– Set up and run board meetings end\-to\-end — agenda, pre\-reads, materials, minutes, action tracking
  
  

– Own the CEO's external calendar strategy — not logistics, but which rooms matter and why
  
  

– Manage the quarterly MIS and board reporting cadence
  
  

CEO Office Communications (Working with Marketing and HR)
  
  

– Draft all CEO\-level internal and external communications — all\-hands, board notes, partner letters
  
  

– Prepare briefing documents before every external meeting — context, objective, risks, ask
  
  

– Support and occasionally ghostwrite thought leadership content
  
  

Org Change Management (Working with HR leaders)
  
  

– Translate CEO decisions into structured change communications
  
  

– Track org changes, restructures, and HR\-level actions to closure
  
  

– Coordinate with HR on sensitive matters that require CEO office involvement
  
  

Who You Are
  
  

Non\-negotiable
  
  

– 6–10 years of experience in strategy consulting (Big 4 / MBB), investment banking, or a Chief of Staff role at a fast\-scaling company or worked with CxO office in consulting company.
  
  

– Financially literate — you can read a P\&L, understand valuation frameworks, and engage with financial documents without needing a primer
  
  

– Exceptional written communicator in English — board packs, executive memos, and CEO notes live or die on this
  
  

– Has operated in high\-trust, high\-ambiguity environments — you have held information that required discretion
  
  

– Has managed upward — you can push back on the CEO, flag slippage, and hold rooms accountable without authority
  
  

– Pune\-based or willing to relocate immediately — this role requires physical presence, every day
  
  

Strongly Preferred
  
  

– Exposure to senior external engagement processes — structured documentation, due diligence\-style reviews, executive Q\&A
  
  

– Experience in a technology or data/AI company — you understand what platform businesses and SaaSadjacent models look like
  
  

– Prior experience coordinating cross\-functional projects across geographies
  
  

– Comfort with CRM tools, pipeline dashboards, and executive reporting frameworks
  
  

What We Will Train
  
  

– SalesOps mechanics and CRM governance — this is learnable with structure
  
  

– External stakeholder engagement etiquette and norms — learnable with exposure – Hoonartek's strategic context: our product, our clients, our competitive positioning
  
  

What This Role Is Not
  
  

– A remote or hybrid position — presence is the job
  
  

– A support role — you will be expected to own outcomes, not assist with them
  
  

– A role with a slow ramp — strategic workstreams are live, clients are active, the pace is real
  
  

– A stepping stone to something comfortable — this is a high\-demand, high\-growth seat
  
  

What You Get
  
  

– A front\-row view of how a 1,000\-person Data \& AI company is built and scaled
  
  

– Direct access to senior strategic decisions, board\-level governance, and high\-stakes external engagements
  
  

– Compensation benchmarked to senior strategy / consulting professionals in Pune
  
  

– ESOP participation — you will have skin in the outcome
  
  

– A CEO who will invest in your development and trust you with the real work
  
  

About Hoonartek
  
  

Hoonartek is a Data, AI, and cloud transformation company headquartered in Pune, India, with presence in the US and APAC. Founded 15 years ago as a specialist data engineering firm, Hoonartek has evolved into a modern platform company with proprietary IP — including ClearView, a governed decision intelligence layer built on Databricks and Google Cloud.
  
  

We are a Databricks Elite Partner and Google Cloud partner, with marquee clients across BFSI, telecom, manufacturing, and healthcare globally.
  
  

Hoonar means skill or craft. Tek is precision engineering. That is who we are.

description:
**Role Overview**  

TartanHQ is looking for a **motivated and target\-driven sales professional** to join our Enterprise Sales team in **Gurugram**.  

The role will focus on **new business development**, including identifying potential customers, generating leads, connecting with decision\-makers, understanding customer requirements, and converting opportunities into business.  

We are looking for someone with **2–4 years of B2B sales experience** who is eager to build a career in enterprise sales. The candidate should have a strong **hunter mindset**, be comfortable with outbound sales, and enjoy engaging with customers.  

You will work closely with the senior sales team and the CBO to identify and acquire new customers across mid\-market and enterprise accounts. **Key Responsibilities*** **New Business Development**
* Identify and research potential mid\-market and enterprise customers.
* Generate new leads through cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, networking, and other outbound channels.
* Reach out to prospective customers and create new sales opportunities.
* Identify and connect with relevant decision\-makers across HR, Finance, and IT.
* Understand customer requirements, business challenges, and potential use cases.
* Schedule and conduct introductory calls and customer meetings.
* Present TartanHQ's solutions and communicate the value proposition effectively.
* Follow up with prospects and move opportunities through the sales funnel.
* Support senior team members in larger and more complex enterprise deals.
* Work towards achieving assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.

* **Pipeline \& Sales Management**

  

* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Qualify leads and identify genuine business opportunities.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups and ensure clear next steps for every opportunity.
* Prepare proposals, presentations, and commercial discussions with support from the sales team.
* Coordinate with Product, Solutions, Marketing, and other internal teams whenever required.
* Keep CRM information updated with accurate opportunity status, activities, and next steps.
* Participate in regular pipeline and sales reviews.

* **Customer \& Market Engagement**

  

* Build strong relationships with prospects and customers.
* Understand customer needs and recommend relevant solutions.
* Keep track of market trends, customer requirements, and competitor activities.
* Participate in industry events, conferences, networking activities, and customer meetings.
* Share customer feedback and market insights with the Sales, Product, and Marketing teams.

 **Key KPIs**  

* New business / ARR generated against assigned target.
* Number of qualified opportunities generated.
* Number of new customer meetings.
* Self\-sourced pipeline generated.
* Pipeline value and coverage.
* Lead\-to\-opportunity and opportunity\-to\-closure conversion.
* New logos acquired.
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* CRM hygiene and accurate sales forecasting.

 **Required Skills \& Qualifications*** **2–4 years of experience in B2B Sales / Business Development / Enterprise Sales.**
* Experience in **SaaS, Fintech, HR Tech, Technology, API, or similar B2B products** will be preferred.
* Strong experience in **outbound sales and lead generation**.
* Ability to identify prospects and independently generate meetings.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and position solutions accordingly.
* Comfortable speaking with mid\-level and senior stakeholders.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
* Target\-oriented and comfortable working in a performance\-driven environment.
* Basic understanding of CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings when required.

 **Preferred Experience**  

* Experience selling to **HR, Finance, IT, or Business teams**.
* Exposure to mid\-market or enterprise customers.
* Experience in a high\-growth startup environment.
* Prior experience in SaaS, Fintech, HR Tech, Payroll, or financial technology solutions.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Management, or a related field would be an advantage.

 **What We Look For** **Hunter Mindset**
You enjoy finding new prospects, making calls, creating opportunities, and winning new customers. **Target Orientation**
You are motivated by sales targets and enjoy working in a performance\-driven environment. **Ownership**
You take responsibility for your leads, pipeline, follow\-ups, and customer relationships. **Communication**
You can confidently communicate with customers, understand their requirements, and present solutions clearly. **Learning Agility**
You are curious, willing to learn, and able to understand and sell a technology\-led solution. **Resilience**
You don't give up easily and are comfortable with rejection, follow\-ups, and longer sales cycles. **Career Growth**  

* This role provides an opportunity to build strong expertise in **B2B and Enterprise Sales** while working closely with experienced sales leaders.
* High performers will have the opportunity to take ownership of larger accounts and progress into **Manager / Senior Manager / Enterprise Sales** roles based on performance.

 **Incentive Structure**  

* Competitive fixed compensation with a performance\-linked incentive.
* Incentives linked to achievement of assigned sales targets.
* Higher performance will attract higher incentive payouts.
* Strong earning potential for consistent performers.

  

Location**Gurugram (Gurgaon) – Work From Office**

title: Business Development
description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.  

Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare. **About the Role:**
At Fynd Create, we are looking for a hunter\-profile Business Development \& Marketing Manager to build and scale our apparel export business across the UK and EU. This is a revenue\-owning role: the mandate is to convert relationships into confirmed, seasonally\-booked business with retailers, brands, in the region. The ideal candidate already carries a book of retailer relationships in the UK/EU and understands how to position South Asian manufacturing capability (India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka) against buyer expectations on price, quality, and speed. **What will you do at Fynd ?****Business Development*** Own and grow a pipeline of UK/EU retailers, brands, and private\-label buyers, converting prospects into confirmed seasonal order books (booked business value, not just leads).
* Leverage existing retailer relationships to open doors quickly; this role is not built around cold\-market entry from zero.
* Lead commercial negotiations on price, MOQs, payment terms, and seasonal calendars in line with company margin targets.
* Build and manage a rolling seasonal business plan (SS/AW/Holiday) with revenue targets by account and by country.

* Identify serious buyers versus low\-intent prospects.
* Maintain structured follow\-up until closure or a clearly defined outcome.
* Generate referrals and additional opportunities from existing customers.

* Update every call, visit, and follow\-up and customer outcome on the same working day.
* Maintain a clear next\-action date for every active prospect.
* Share daily activity updates and weekly sales forecasts.
* Track individual funnel performance from site visit through booking.

* CRM accuracy and same\-day updating
* Revisit conversion

* Comfortable conducting sales discussions independently.
* Able to handle customers and family decision\-makers confidently.
